info.name: Market
info.summary: Browse, install and update apps from the marketplace or a local catalog inside owncloud.online
info.description:
Easily manage owncloud.online apps from within your owncloud.online web interface. This BW-Tech fork connects to the owncloud.online marketplace by default and additionally ships a fully self-contained, local app catalog for offline use (set `appstoreurl` to `local` or a `file://` path). It comes with a refreshed light UI with live search. Apps can be downloaded from any URL declared in `marketplace/apps.json` (for example GitHub releases).
This is a community fork maintained by BW-Tech GmbH for owncloud.online. Original code by ownCloud GmbH.
To use this application click on "Apps" in the top left corner and click on "Market" (cart icon) (Administrator privileges required).
